relations: The hands compress the magnetic spheres into a single dense cluster.
Pulling the right hand separates a ring-shaped section from the main mass held by the left.
Releasing the left hand drops the remaining larger pile onto the white surface.
Placing the separated ring down creates two distinct piles of spheres.
caption: The video depicts a pair of hairy hands holding a large, dense cluster of shiny black magnetic spheres over a plain white surface. Initially, the hands grip the entire mass firmly, compressing the balls together into a single unit. The right hand then begins to pull a smaller section of the cluster away from the main group held by the left hand. As the separation continues, the right hand lifts a distinct ring-shaped formation of spheres while the left hand releases the remaining larger pile onto the table. The left hand briefly touches the separated ring before moving back towards the main cluster on the left. Finally, the right hand places the small ring down on the surface to the right of the larger group and withdraws completely. Two separate piles of black spheres remain resting on the white background.
